# `passportsim device_boot_check`

Read the AI Passport's boot console against an image, optionally restarting it first.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `device` |
| MCP tool | `passport_device_boot_check` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/device_boot_check` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `native_only`, `human_confirm` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no |

Where it does not run, `E_HOST_UNSUPPORTED` names the alternative: run it with the native CLI on the macOS or Windows host the Passport is attached to, built with feature `device`; `plan_flash` plans on every host

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim device_boot_check <image> [--port <PORT>] [--reset] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | `<image>` | `string` | yes | A merged `.bin` of the whole 8 MB part. A build directory is refused in v1. |
| `port` | `--port <PORT>` | `string` \| `null` | no | A discovered 303A:1001 port; required when several are attached. |
| `reset` | `--reset` | `boolean` | no | Restart the device first, then read the boot console the restart produces. Without it an already-booted Passport is silent and no banner can be seen. The restart is confirmed in its own words; no byte is written to the device. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/device_boot_check.input.json`](../schema/commands/device_boot_check.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/device_boot_check.output.json`](../schema/commands/device_boot_check.output.json).

| `E_DEVICE_BUSY` | 5001 |

Every code is listed in [`docs/errors.md`](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Restart the Passport and check that it booted the official image

```sh
passportsim device_boot_check --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "image": "FoloToy-AI-Passport-8MB.bin",
  "reset": true
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "image": "FoloToy-AI-Passport-8MB.bin",
  "reset": true
}
'@ | passportsim device_boot_check --json -
```
